content.title: Sporting CP vs Bodo/Glimt - Live Stream
content.text: View the live stream and TV coverage details and live score for the Sporting CP vs Bodo/Glimt, a UEFA Champions League 1/8 final.Sporting CP host Bodø/Glimt in a decisive UEFA Champions League Round of 16 second leg on Tuesday, March 17, 2026, at the Estádio José Alvalade in Lisbon, with the Portuguese side facing a huge uphill battle after a 3–0 defeat in the first leg in Norway. The Norwegian champions have been one of the stories of the season—already eliminating top European sides—and arrive full of confidence, while Sporting will rely on their strong home form to attempt a dramatic comeback. Kick-off is scheduled for 18:45 CET (Lisbon local time) / 1:45 PM US Eastern.Sporting CP vs Bodo/Glimt – TV & Streaming CoverageCountry / RegionChannel / Package / StreamingGreat BritainViewers in UK can watch the match live on: TNT Sports Channel 3Discovery +ItalyIn Italy fans can access the live coverage on: Sky Sport channel 255SKY Go ItaliaNOW TVGermanyDAZN Germany.NetherlandsZiggo Sports will provide live coverage in Netherlands.BelgiumFootball fans in Belgium can follow the match live on:Proximus PickxPlay SportsSpainMovistar Plus+ – M+ Liga de Campeones channel 2 will broadcast the match live in Spain.SwedenThe live coverage of the match will be available on Viaplay.NorwayThe Norwegian football fans can watch the match live on TV 2 Play.PortugalIn Portugal the game will be broadcast live on Sport TV Channel 5.FranceCanal Plus and My Canal will provide live coverage for French football fans.United StatesSoccer fans in the US can watch the match live on:Fubo TVParamount+ (English commentary)ViX (Spanish commentary)CBS Sports NetworkTUDNCanadaCanadian football fans follow the match live on DAZN and Fubo TV Canada.WorldwideSee UEFA Champions League Broadcast Partners by Country.If you're abroad and experiencing difficulties accessing the live stream from your current location, consider using a Virtual Private Network (VPN) service. One option for a VPN service is Pure VPN.Note: Broadcast schedules and partners are subject to change. We recommend checking your local listings regularly for the most up-to-date information.Team NewsSporting CPSporting are close to full strength but remain without Fotis Ioannidis, Giorgi Kochorashvili, and Ricardo Mangas. However, they are boosted by the availability of key attacking players like Pedro Gonçalves and Francisco Trincão, who will be central to any comeback attempt.Bodø/GlimtBodø/Glimt travel to Lisbon with no major injury concerns, maintaining a settled and confident squad following their dominant first-leg win. Their attacking trio—led by Kasper Høgh and supported by Jens Petter Hauge—has been in excellent form throughout the competition.Predicted LineupsSporting CP (4-2-3-1)GK: Rui SilvaDEF: Fresneda, Diomande, Gonçalo Inácio, AraújoMID: Hjulmand, MoritaATT: Geny Catamo, Francisco Trincão, Pedro GonçalvesST: Luis SuárezBodø/Glimt (4-3-3)GK: Nikita HaikinDEF: Sjøvold, Bjørtuft, Gundersen, BjørkanMID: Evjen, Patrick Berg, Brunstad FetATT: Blomberg, Kasper Høgh, Jens Petter Hauge
